  -- When model is run as incremental, update data from starting from the meta ads days back setting in workflow settings yaml
  where
      date(_airbyte_extracted_at) > date '2024-01-01'
preOps:
-- Set backstop and defaults
      declare self_checkpoint default (select timestamp("2024-01-01"));
      declare partitions_to_update
          array<
              struct<
                  site_nm string, 
                  partition_dates array<date>
              >
          >;
      declare log_start_time default (select current_timestamp());
      
      -- Get last run time for model *table_name* from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS
      set self_checkpoint = (
          select timestamp("2024-01-01")
      );
      
      -- Iterate through all sources and find partitions from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS
      -- that have updated since the last run time.
      set partitions_to_update = array(
          select as struct
              site_nm,
              array_agg(distinct partition_date ignore nulls) as partition_dates
          from (
              
                  select
                      "meta_ads" as site_nm,
                      parse_date('%Y%m%d', partition_id) as partition_date
                  from `propeller-development.meta_ads.INFORMATION_SCHEMA.PARTITIONS`
                  where
                    table_name = "ads_insights"
                      -- Subtract 10 minutes to account for the runtime.  TODO log start time.
                      and last_modified_time > timestamp_sub(self_checkpoint, interval 10 minute)         
              
          )
              group by site_nm
              having array_length(partition_dates) > 0
      );

--Extract top level metrics by day
select
    data_date,
    date_start,
    date_stop,
    account_id,
    account_name,
    ad_id,
    ad_name,
    objective,
    buying_type,
    attribution_setting,
    sum(reach) as reach,
    sum(impressions) as impressions,
    sum(frequency) as frequency,
    sum(clicks) as clicks,
    sum(unique_clicks) as unique_clicks,
    sum(spend) as spend,
    sum(cpc) as cpc,
    sum(cpm) as cpm,
    sum(cpp) as cpp,
    sum(ctr) as ctr
from
    `df-warehouse.propeller_dataform_template_sample_client.stg_meta_ads_insights`
where
    data_date > date '2024-01-01'    
group by
    data_date,
    date_start,
    date_stop,
    account_id,
    account_name,
    ad_id,
    ad_name,
    objective,
    buying_type,
    attribution_setting

tables.query:
--Extract top level attributes by day
with daily_metrics as (
    select
        data_date,
        date_start,
        date_stop,
        account_id,
        account_name,
        campaign_id,
        campaign_name,
        adset_id,
        adset_name,
        ad_id,
        ad_name,
        objective,
        buying_type,
        attribution_setting
    from
        `df-warehouse.propeller_dataform_template_sample_client.stg_meta_ads_insights`
    where
        data_date > date '2024-01-01'        
)

-- Get the most recent attributes
select
    data_date,
    date_start,
    date_stop,
    account_id,
    account_name,
    campaign_id,
    campaign_name,
    adset_id,
    adset_name,
    ad_id,
    ad_name,
    objective,
    buying_type,
    attribution_setting
from
    daily_metrics
qualify
    row_number() over (
        partition by data_date,
                     date_start,
                     date_stop,
                     account_id,
                     account_name,
                     campaign_id,
                     campaign_name,
                     adset_id,
                     adset_name,
                     ad_id,
                     ad_name,
                     objective,
                     buying_type,
                     attribution_setting
    order by data_date desc
) = 1
